titles.romaji: Sekai wa Mada Hajimatte sura Inai
titles.english: The World Hasn’t Even Started Yet
titles.native: セカイはまだ始まってすらいない

description:
This is a music video by Pinnochio-P feat. the voice of Vocaloid-singer Hatsune Miku.

This animation takes elements from clay and watercolors and combines them to create a 3D animated artistic look. It centeres around the theme, that the full world does not exist yet. It started as a commissioned song for the unit Wonderlands×Showtime for the game Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku.
